calculation_handling.description: Lists the uses permitted in the RD zone only when they meet the numbered conditions in 10.20.20.100; the permission itself carries no numeric value. The parenthesised numbers are references to condition clauses in 10.20.20.100 (regulation references, not limits), so none is keyed as a literal.
calculation_handling.gaps: Each use's actual conditions live in 10.20.20.100 and are keyed there; this unit only records that the suites are permitted subject to those conditions.

10.20.20.20(1).explanation: In the RD zone a secondary suite, garden suite or laneway suite (and a list of mostly non-residential uses) is allowed only if it meets the specific conditions set out for it in 10.20.20.100.
